text:
sam: heads up — noticed large stutter on dashboard widgets after this morning's canary. charts freeze for ~200-500ms on frame boundary. :eyes:

deploy-bot: canary v2026.3 rolled to us-east-1 at 2026-03-20T09:14:40Z (instances: 4)

lena: confirmed on prod canary. repro steps: open org dashboard -> switch time range -> scroll list of charts. CPU spikes in main thread, repeated reflows.

raj: seeing a bunch of repeated GET /api/metrics?prefetch=false from the client, almost identical query params. looks like we lost a short-circuit dedupe at routing layer after the routing-policy change in PR #4567.

sam: interesting — latency graphs show a tail of 400-600ms tokens. bundle size didn't change much but network waterfall shows multiple duplicate metric calls within 30ms of each other.

perf-bot: sampled flame: main-thread -> render -> setState -> fetch -> render -> setState (loop) — likely caused by telemetry updates triggering setState on parent list.

talia: also seeing quota WARNs in the API gateway logs around the same time: "quota_exceeded: read_ops" then 502s. when quota 429s happen we fallback to a fresh fetch which invalidates the KV cache prefix. that triggers new telemetry events -> rerender -> more requests. feedback loop.

lena: reproduced locally by flipping my dev routing policy to "prefer-dedicated" (mirrors PR effect). after that, kv cache key namespace changed (tenant->route prefix), so cached responses miss and we do immediate refetches.

raj: exact suspect commit: api/routing: honor per-tenant override (commit 9c1f2b). it changed route key used for cache key from `tenant_id` to `tenant_route|tenant_id`. That broke cross-route cache hits.

sam: ok — potential action items: revert the routing-key change for fetch dedupe, add a telemetry debounce (100ms) around list-level updates, and put a short circuit in frontend fetcher to coalesce identical in-flight requests.

talia: agree. quick mitigation: increase gateway quota throttle window to avoid immediate 429s during canary (~5m). also add a flag to keep old cache key for 24h until we migrate.

raj: I can open a revert PR for the routing key and add a feature flag behind env ROUTING_USE_NEW_KEY. PR draft: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4792

lena: I'll prototype debounce + coalesce in the dashboard list component. local perf: debounce 120ms saved ~60% of reflows in my test.

perf-bot: perf snapshot: before: 18% frame drops at 60s load, after debounce: 3% frame drops.

sam: nice. can we land revert + debounce as a hotspot hotfix? want to canary them together but keep revert first.

raj: revert PR created, requested reviews from @sam and @talia. also added migration flag in the PR description.

talia: starting a temporary quota bump in gateway for us-east-1 now. will monitor 10m window.

sam: thanks. once deploy done, i'll watch real-user throughput and run the dashboard perf script: ./scripts/load-dashboard.sh --org=acme --rate=50

lena: attaching a small patch for coalescing logic (WIP):

```
// pseudo
const inFlight = new Map();
function fetchMetrics(key, fn) {
  if (inFlight.has(key)) return inFlight.get(key);
  const p = fn().finally(() => inFlight.delete(key));
  inFlight.set(key, p);
  return p;
}
```

sam: perfect. please include unit test for coalesce and a small e2e. i'll queue the canary hotfix after revert merges. :thumbsup:

perf-bot: monitoring hooks enabled for the canary: charts/jank-rate, api/duplicate-requests, kvcache/miss-rate. will post alerts to #incidents if regressions exceed thresholds.

talia: quick note — if we keep the new routing-key long term we should version the cache keys with a migration window, and maybe a fallback read that tries old key before issuing fetch. that avoids double fetch.

sam: good idea. long-term = migrate with dual-read fallback + metric to measure old-key hits. short-term = revert + debounce + coalesce + quota bump.

lena: closing loop: I'll prepare the frontend PR (WIP) and drop screenshots once green.

raj: revert merged to canary branch, infra rolling now.

sam: cheers — monitoring closely. will report back with perf graphs in ~20m.

perf-bot: alert: duplicate-requests rate down 78% since revert start.

sam: that's promising. follow-up: schedule a postmortem if this hits prod, and add a checklist for routing-key changes in infra docs.

lena: noted. I'll draft the docs change and add it to the release checklist.

sam: thanks all. :heart:
